title: Salivary Protein Extraction and Precipitation Protocol
author: Jennifer Orozco Paez
materials: Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Collect and Dilute Saliva
steps.instruction: Collect at least 5 mL of saliva into a 15 mL Falcon tube and dilute with an equal volume of Milli-Q water (1:1 v/v ratio).

steps.title: Homogenize and Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture for 30 seconds and centrifuge at 3500 rpm for 25 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and divide it into four 1000 µL portions, then store at -40°C.

steps.title: Precipitate Proteins
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL of 20% TCA solution to each 1000 µL saliva aliquot and precipitate the proteins.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 30 minutes at 4°C

steps.title: Perform First Acetone Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet using cold 90% acetone.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of cold 90% acetone to the pellet
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C

steps.title: Perform Second Acetone Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet using cold 80% acetone.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of cold 80% acetone to the pellet
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove residual acetone and solubilize the protein pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 10 µL of 0.2 M NaOH
Incubate the solution for 2 minutes at room temperature

steps.title: Dissolve Proteins in 2D Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 2D buffer to the solution and ensure complete dissolution.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 2D buffer (Urea 7 M, Thiourea 2 M, CHAPS 4%)

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and determine the protein concentration using the Bradford assay according to the manufacturer's instructions.
